WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.customer_name,
           COALESCE(SUM(p.product_price), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM Customers c
    LEFT JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
    LEFT JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    LEFT JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
)

FROM customer_spend
WHERE total_spent = (SELECT MAX(total_spent) FROM customer_spend);
